status: Exploratory persistence follow-up; primary contrast unchanged
method: Let every matched unprobed causal field evolve unforced for the waiting time. For wait 0.8 reuse its already-recorded complete unprobed endpoint. For wait 0.4 integrate from the recorded initial field. Then clone each waiting state with/without the same fixed probe. Observe from the same fixed initial center/neighborhood positions in every arm; resetting passive observation markers exerts no fluid force. This controls measurement location while assessing the evolved fluid structure.
interpretation: Waiting tests persistence of the candidate's effect before a later disturbance; extending observation time alone is a separate test. A four-flow pilot is exploratory and cannot establish an asymptotic memory lifetime. Low coefficients and spectra, which were matched at erasure, need not remain matched after nonlinear evolution.
checks: Hash-check reused full-field checkpoints; retain all waiting states, marker/tangent traces, response-field snapshots, energy/divergence/volume diagnostics and grid/time comparisons.
